newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's long-term March future hits record high at 114.00.
newsitem.headline: Spain's long-term March future hits record high at 114.00.

text.p: The Spanish long-term March future. contract was sharply higher on Monday morning when it set a string of record highs.

At 1237 GMT, the contract rose above the 114.00 barrier and set a new record high at 114.04. At the same time the 10-year spread over Bunds traded down to 93 basis points, a new record low set on Friday.
The peseta, buoyant versus the mark, was trading at 83.40/3.42 per mark.
